one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0.00 from Waterline Reservoir: the $5.10M borrower's HF 1.0057 is a mark-to-model artifact of a monotone rate oracle that cannot be written down, the position is improving (10.01% collateral vs 9.22% borrow), and even a forced liquidation's 2.62% bonus is eaten by the 5% instant-exit fee and an unfunded $30 vault; the real $11.52M risk is the Agua ADMIN EOA custody, not an outsider.
